problem.invalid_value: The previous {{row}}, {{previous}}, is no longer offered. Choose again
problem.null_required: {{row}} can no longer be None. Choose a value
problem.removed: {{row}} (previously {{previous}}) was removed from the settings, so this conversation can't be continued. {{next}}
problem.unused: {{row}} (previously {{previous}}) is no longer used by the launch options, so this conversation can't be continued. {{next}}

draft.discardConfirm: Discard this draft? This cannot be undone.
draft.reviewLatest: Review the latest version and keep editing
draft.storageUnavailable: Draft storage is unavailable. Sending is paused to prevent duplicates. Keep this page open and copy your draft.

folderInput.made: This is a newly created folder.
folderInput.name: New folder name

problem.long: The name is too long (255 bytes maximum).
problem.taken: A folder with this name already exists.

folderInput.truncated: Only the first {{limit}} are shown. Close the list and type a name in the field to narrow them.

moveForm.adopt: Use the latest version and choose again
moveForm.changedElsewhere: The parent changed elsewhere after this form opened (then: {{opened}}, now: {{current}}). Moving now would be refused.
moveForm.note: The task keeps its ID, folder and runs; running work is not stopped, and its reports go to the new parent from now on
moveForm.refused: Not moved: the task changed elsewhere (parent then: {{opened}}, now: {{current}}). Your choice is kept.

reportForm.chooseAgain: The task has changed. Choose its state again
reportForm.heading: Change the state of {{id}}
reportForm.reportTitleHint: The point of the report, in one line
reportForm.restoreDescription: Back to its state before the hold.
reportForm.stopDescription: Stops this task and the tasks under it.

responsibleForm.choiceUnavailable: The selected agent or launch profile is no longer available. This form was closed.
responsibleForm.noProfiles: No agents are enabled. Install and sign in to an AI, then enable it in Settings → Server
responsibleForm.replaceNote: {{name}} stops being the owner and stays in History without becoming a member
responsibleForm.taskUnavailable: This task is no longer available. This form was closed.

runForm.noLongerAvailable: This run can no longer be closed. This form was closed.

writeFailure.conflict: Nothing was saved. Review the latest content before continuing.
writeFailure.operationUnconfirmed: Couldn't confirm the result. Sending again reuses the same ID: if it hasn't arrived, it runs now; an operation already received won't run twice.
writeFailure.unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm whether it was sent. Resending is paused to prevent duplicates. Close with your input kept, then check the latest content or run records.
writeFailure.unproven: Sending it again could run it twice, so it won't be sent. Copy what you need and continue in a new tab.
